__comment: Unifying ramadandelight:small_dough into c:foods/dough turns Ramadan's 'small_dough_from_dough' (1x c:foods/dough -> 2x small_dough) into an item-duplication loop. We disable that recipe (override at data/ramadandelight/recipe/small_dough_from_dough.json) and re-add a non-duplicating cutting-board path on a Farmer's Delight station, preserving access to small_dough.
